literal: Brightness lost, that-became-dull eyes too; he went days having-touched, that-wore-away fingers.
translation: My eyes have lost their brightness and grown dull, and my fingers are worn away from touching the marks to count the days since he left.
modern: அவர் பிரிந்து சென்ற நாட்களைத் தொட்டு எண்ணி என் விரல்கள் தேய்ந்துவிட்டன; அவர் வரும் வழியைப் பார்த்து என் கண்களும் ஒளியிழந்து மங்கிவிட்டன.
explanation: The speaker expresses the physical toll of her prolonged yearning for her lover's return. Her eyes have lost their natural luster from constantly watching the road for him. Meanwhile, her fingers have worn down from the daily habit of touching marks to count the days since his departure. The vivid imagery of dull eyes and worn fingers emphasizes the sheer length of the separation and the depth of her longing.
